plan.cover_image_prompt: reception desk of a local medical clinic, patient arranging an appointment, realistic photo, warm indoor light, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner is contacting a local clinic to book a doctor's appointment because they have had a sore throat and fever for three days. They need a convenient appointment time and must briefly explain what is wrong.
Learner: the learner is a patient. Partner: the partner is a receptionist.
Learner must be able to: say they want to make a doctor's appointment; briefly explain they have a sore throat and fever for three days; understand and choose between available times; ask how the appointment is arranged and what time to come.
Partner will: ask what the problem is; offer available times or dates; give basic instructions about the appointment.
Not in this scene: detailed symptom description, medical questions from the doctor, diagnosis, treatment, prescription.
scenes.image_prompt: clinic reception desk with appointment calendar and patient speaking to receptionist, realistic photo, soft indoor light, no text, no logos, no faces in close-up

scenes.topic_description:
Situation: The learner is at the doctor's appointment after booking it at the clinic. They have had a sore throat and fever for three days and need to explain the problem clearly in a simple way.
Learner: the learner is a patient. Partner: the partner is a doctor.
Learner must be able to: say where it hurts and for how many days; mention fever and other simple symptoms; answer basic questions from the doctor; understand simple advice about rest, medicine, or what to do next.
Partner will: ask about symptoms and duration; ask simple follow-up questions such as temperature or cough; give a basic recommendation or treatment advice.
Not in this scene: booking the appointment, choosing a time, front-desk arrangements, buying medicine at a pharmacy.
